newsitem.title: USA: Amazon.com cuts prices on 400,000 titles.
newsitem.headline: Amazon.com cuts prices on 400,000 titles.

text.p: Amazon.com Inc said early Tuesday it plans to cut prices on more than 400,000 book titles it offers for sale via its World Wide Web page.
Every hardcover is at least 30 percent off and every paperback is at least 20 percent off. Specially featured books are discounted 40 percent.

"We've always offered the biggest selection, and with these prices, Amazon.com offers the lowest everyday book prices anywhere in the world, online or off," Amazon.com founder and Chief Executive Jeff Bezos said in a statement.
Amazon.com has a catalog of 2.5 million titles that it offers online.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
